hook: In October 2026, the Iguazú Falls faced a massive surge from the Super El Niño phenomenon.

sections.voiceover: In October 2026, the Iguazú Falls faced a massive surge from the Super El Niño phenomenon.
How did this extreme weather impact the Iguazu River flow rate in the border region?
But the surge grew so dangerous that Argentina national park officials closed the Iguazú Falls.
Incredibly, the Iguazu River surged at 6 times its normal flow rate during October 2026. Officials temporarily closed the Iguazú Falls complex to protect visitors from the dangerous floodwaters.
El Niño rains triggered widespread flooding across Argentina, Paraguay, and Uruguay throughout October 2026.
